reviews.review:
Truck City is a logistics and resource allocation game that is also a puzzle as to how to proceed. It is similar to the “Logistical” game series but without the towns and businesses.

You produce resources to feed factories that feed other factories that feed other factories until you achieve your objectives.

You spend most of you time checking that your many factories are running efficiently. Some factories are over producing which causes storages to seize up, other factories are receiving no resources. Traffic jams are occurring. So, you have to track down the constant problems and rectify them. 

Your brain is constantly busy, but game progress is slow. You can’t achieve your objectives quickly. You are forced to slow down and be methodical.

It is also a puzzle as to what to do next. Do I need to do research to progress or to build a new different factory? The research tree is massive. What do I have to do in order to progress? This can be frustrating. So, you are forced to just try everything and hope you did the right thing. It works out okay eventually.

Truck City is an intriguing, simple little (BIG) logistics/puzzle game that will keep your brain busy and give your patience a good work out. It is also a little bit addictive as you try to keep your economy running smoothly.

Highly recommended.
